request.query: Research using the UCI Online Shoppers Purchasing Intention Dataset or comparable e-commerce session data that evaluates the incremental association or predictive value of SpecialDay/calendar-proximity features conditional on Month and session context; distinguish this from generic conversion prediction.
request.missing_relation: Whether the conditional SpecialDay-beyond-Month contrast has been directly evaluated and how the feature’s date-derived meaning is interpreted.
request.change_if_found: If a close study tests this contrast, revise toward a discriminating extension or withdraw any novelty implication. If none is returned, retain novelty as unverified.
